description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of categories within a dataset, showing seven distinct segments: Math (29.3%, pink), Coding (24.3%, blue), Information Seeking (22.2%, light green), Reasoning (10.4%, tan), Planning (2.3%, light purple), Creative Writing (2.2%, pinkish), and Others (combined) at 9.3% (light green). The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps each category to its corresponding color and provides the raw count for each, and percentage labels are also displayed directly on the chart for each slice. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with Math at the top left and proceeding clockwise. The chart does not feature any exploded or emphasized slices, and all segments are clearly delineated with black borders.
